title: Rate limiting: shed or scale?
brief: The API below is built for about 5k rps and costs $1.73/hr. Traffic just jumped to 15k rps and everything is timing out, real users included. Decide whether to turn traffic away or add capacity, then do it.

requirements: 15k rps, 90% reads: 5k from real users, 10k from a scraper
Rejecting the scraper is fine, but keep at least 5k rps served: errors at most 70%
p99 < 250 ms for the requests you accept
variants.twist: The scraper doubles: 25k rps total, still 5k real. Apply with set_requirements(rps=25000, error_pct=82). Does your limit still protect p99 without any new servers?

requirements: 12k rps, 90% reads, all real users after a launch
variants.twist: Launch spike: traffic doubles for 20 s. Apply with spike(multiplier=2, seconds=20). After it ends, does p99 come back on its own?

hints: How much of the traffic do you actually need to serve? What happens to everyone when the API tries to serve all of it?
An API gateway drops requests above its rate limit before they reach your servers. Where would it go, and what limit keeps 8 replicas comfortable?

Scraper: put an API gateway between the client and the load balancer with rate_limit_rps around 5000 (8 replicas at about 60% busy). Real growth: a limiter would reject real users; add service replicas until utilization is about 0.6 instead.
_notes: Starter: client -> LB ($0.03) -> 8 x 1k service ($0.80) -> KV 3 x 10k ($0.90) = $1.73/hr. At 15k the service is at rho ~1.9, queues to its 1 s timeout and client retries pile on (sim: p99 ~13 s, 74% errors). Scraper: gateway ($0.05) with rate_limit_rps 5000 -> sim p99 182 ms, errors 66.7% (10k of 15k rejected), $1.78. A 4000 limit rejects too much (73% > 70%); 6000 leaves the service at rho 0.75 (p99 305 ms). Scaling instead needs ~25 replicas ($3.43) and breaks $2. The sim can't tell scraper requests from user ones: a global limit and a per-client limit score the same here; a real system would limit per API key or IP, so ask which one they'd build. Real growth: 12k needs ~20 replicas (sim p99 161 ms, $2.93); 18 gives 205 ms; a 5k gateway gives 58% errors; 28 replicas ($3.73) breaks the budget. Twist (scraper): at 25k the 5k limit still holds p99 at 182 ms (errors 80%). Checked in frontend/src/lessons/content.test.ts.
